product.title: 6 Hours - Singapore Tour in Private Car or Minibus with Driver

description.text: In Singapore, this private six-hour car or minibus charter leaves a hotel lobby for a published highlights list rather than a shared coach loop. The driver can keep Merlion Park, the Singapore River, Raffles City, China Square, Buddha Tooth Relic Temple and Museum, Little India, Mount Faber Park, Henderson Waves, Marina Bay, Gardens by the Bay, and Sentosa Island on the window, or swap stops when the group wants more time at a ridge or quarter. An air-conditioned vehicle and bottled water are listed; entrance fees stay separate. Jurong, Woodlands, and Malaysian-border pickups carry a published surcharge. The format suits visitors who want a guided island circuit without assembling MRT transfers independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on Merlion Park, Little India, Mount Faber, and Gardens by the Bay that define this private city day rather than a hop-on ticket.
